hints.title: Turn Alternation Counts
hints.text: Count piece counts and check winning lines to verify that game rules and turn alternation were observed.

hints.title: Player Move Balance
hints.text: X always moves first, so count of X must equal count of O or exceed it by exactly one.

hints.title: Terminal Win Invariants
hints.text: If X wins, count of X must be count of O plus one and O cannot also win. If O wins, count of X must equal count of O and X cannot also win.
